title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop | TechCrunch
summary: The company on Friday said it is launching a feature that lets customers chat with its Alexa AI agent over text messages to help them shop, much like you can with AI agents like Muse or Instinct.
